+        ("correct_continuity_correction", ("aggregate", "clt", "normal_probability")),
+    ),
+    "qrow_9709_w22_qp_62_q05::q05/b": (
+        ("no_continuity_correction", ("normal_probability",)),
+        ("correct_continuity_correction", ("normal_probability",)),
+    ),
+}
+
+
+def _load(path: str) -> Any:
+    return json.loads((ROOT / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def _receipt(path: str):
+    return sha256_and_length((ROOT / path).read_bytes())
+
+
+def _rooted_receipt(root: Path, path: str):
+    return sha256_and_length((root / path).read_bytes())
+
+
+def _authenticate_static_predecessor() -> None:
+    p603._authenticate_static_predecessor()
+    for path, expected in P603_RAW_AUTHORITY.items():
+        actual = _receipt(path)
+        if (actual.sha256, actual.byte_length) != expected:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"P6-03 raw-byte predecessor drift: {path}")
+    p603._validate_predecessor_receipt(_load(P603_RECEIPT))
+    if _load(P603_DELTA).get("shard_identity") != "P6-03":
+        raise RuntimeError("P6-03 delta identity drift")
+    p5 = _receipt(P5_TERMINAL_PROJECTION)
+    if (p5.sha256, p5.byte_length) != P5_AUTHORITY:
+        raise RuntimeError("P5 terminal authority drift")
+
+
+def _active_receipts(root: Path) -> dict[str, tuple[str, int]]:
+    return {
+        path: ((value := _rooted_receipt(root, path)).sha256, value.byte_length)
+        for path in P603_ACTIVE_AUTHORITY
+    }
+
+
+def _validate_predecessor_receipt(document: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
+    if (
+        document.get("schema_version") != "9709_p6_04_predecessor_receipt_v1"
+        or document.get("admission") != "PASS"
+        or document.get("active_raw_authentication_count") != 2
+        or document.get("raw_authentication_count") != 6
+        or tuple(document.get("predecessor_shards", ())) != ("P6-01", "P6-02", "P6-03")
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("P6-04 predecessor receipt admission drift")
+    observed = {item["path"]: item for item in document.get("artifacts", [])}
+    expected_paths = tuple(sorted(item[0] for item in P603_EXPECTED_RECEIPT_ARTIFACTS))
+    if tuple(sorted(observed)) != expected_paths:
+        raise RuntimeError("P6-04 predecessor receipt artifact set drift")
+    for path, sha256, byte_length, successor_expected in P603_EXPECTED_RECEIPT_ARTIFACTS:
+        item = observed[path]
+        if (
+            (item.get("sha256"), item.get("byte_length")) != (sha256, byte_length)
+            or item.get("authentication_method") != "sha256_and_length_over_raw_bytes"
+            or item.get("authenticated_before_materialization") is not True
+            or item.get("successor_replacement_expected") is not successor_expected
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"P6-04 predecessor receipt evidence drift: {path}")
+
+
+def _authenticate_current_successor() -> None:
+    manifest = _load(MANIFEST)
+    projection = _load(PROJECTION)
+    if manifest.get("release_version") != "p6-cumulative-v4" or projection.get("release_version") != "p6-cumulative-v4":
+        raise RuntimeError("P6-04 active successor identity drift")
+    outputs = {
+        item["path"]: (item["sha256"], item["byte_length"])
+        for item in manifest.get("output_artifacts", [])
+    }
+    inputs = {
+        item["path"]: (item["sha256"], item["byte_length"])
+        for item in manifest.get("input_artifacts", [])
+    }
+    receipt = _receipt(PREDECESSOR_RECEIPT)
+    if inputs.get(PREDECESSOR_RECEIPT) != (receipt.sha256, receipt.byte_length):
+        raise RuntimeError("P6-04 successor predecessor-receipt custody drift")
+    for path in (DELTA, PROJECTION, READBACK):
+        actual = _receipt(path)
+        if outputs.get(path) != (actual.sha256, actual.byte_length):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"P6-04 active successor custody drift: {path}")
+
+
+def build_predecessor_receipt(active_root: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    _authenticate_static_predecessor()
+    source_root = active_root or ROOT
+    if _active_receipts(source_root) != P603_ACTIVE_AUTHORITY:
+        if active_root is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("P6-03 active raw-byte predecessor drift")
+        _authenticate_current_successor()
+        prior = _load(PREDECESSOR_RECEIPT)
+        _validate_predecessor_receipt(prior)
+        return dict(prior)
+    artifacts = []
+    for path, expected in {**P603_RAW_AUTHORITY, **P603_ACTIVE_AUTHORITY}.items():
+        actual = _rooted_receipt(source_root if path in P603_ACTIVE_AUTHORITY else ROOT, path)
+        if (actual.sha256, actual.byte_length) != expected:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"P6-03 predecessor bytes drifted: {path}")
+        artifacts.append({
+            "authenticated_before_materialization": True,
+            "authentication_method": "sha256_and_length_over_raw_bytes",
+            "byte_length": actual.byte_length,
+            "path": path,
+            "sha256": actual.sha256,
+            "successor_replacement_expected": path in P603_ACTIVE_AUTHORITY,
+        })
+    document = {
+        "active_artifact_authentication_timing": (
+            "The P6-03 active manifest and cumulative projection were opened as raw bytes, "
+            "hashed, length-checked, and admitted before P6-04 materialization. The immutable "
+            "P6-03 receipt authenticates P6-01 and P6-02 custody in the same admitted chain."
+        ),
+        "active_raw_authentication_count": 2,
+        "admission": "PASS",
+        "artifacts": artifacts,
+        "historical_byte_changes": 0,
+        "predecessor_shards": ["P6-01", "P6-02", "P6-03"],
+        "raw_authentication_count": len(artifacts),
+        "schema_version": "9709_p6_04_predecessor_receipt_v1",
+    }
+    _validate_predecessor_receipt(document)
+    return document
+
+
+def _inventory() -> tuple[set[str], set[str], list[str]]:
+    active = p603.p602.p601._active_rows()
+    assignments = p603.p602.p601._family_assignments(active)
+    primary = {qid for qid, family in assignments.items() if family == FAMILY}
+    discovered_from_text: set[str] = set()
+    for row in _load(PLAIN_TEXT)["items"]:
+        if (
+            2020 <= row["year"] <= 2025
+            and row["paper"] == 6
+            and row["variant"] in {1, 2, 3}
+            and DISCOVERY.search(row.get("normalized_plain_text", ""))
+        ):
+            question_id = p603.p602.p601._plain_text_id(row)
+            if question_id in active:
+                discovered_from_text.add(question_id)
+    supporting = set(SUPPORTING_QUESTION_IDS)
+    if len(primary) != 82 or not supporting <= discovered_from_text or primary & supporting:
+        raise RuntimeError("P6-04 live structural inventory drifted")
+    discovered = sorted(primary | supporting)
+    if len(discovered) != 99 or set(discovered) != set(QUESTION_ROUTE_SPECS):
+        raise RuntimeError("P6-04 reviewed route inventory drifted")
+    return primary, supporting, discovered
+
+
+def _approved_routes(active: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]:
+    result: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {}
+    for question_id, route_specs in QUESTION_ROUTE_SPECS.items():
+        score_nodes = [
+            node for node in active[question_id]["structural_nodes"]
+            if node["role"] == "score_owning"
+        ]
+        if len(score_nodes) != len(route_specs):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"P6-04 structural score-owner drift: {question_id}")
+        for node, spec in zip(score_nodes, route_specs, strict=True):
+            if spec == "-":
+                continue
+            routes = tuple(spec.split("+"))
+            if not routes or any(route not in ROUTES for route in routes):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"P6-04 route specification drift: {question_id}")
+            result[f"{question_id}::{node['owner_path']}"] = routes
+    return result
+
+
+def _p602_reused_model() -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    instances = _load(P602_DELTA)["records"]["procedure_instances"]
+    matches = [item for item in instances if item["procedure_model_ref"] == P602_AGGREGATE_MODEL_REF]
+    if not matches:
+        raise RuntimeError("P6-02 aggregate ProcedureModel missing")
+    model = matches[0].get("procedure_model")
+    if not model or model.get("definition") != ROUTES["aggregate"]["definition"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("P6-02 aggregate ProcedureModel definition drifted")
+    return model
+
+
+def _reused_authorities() -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    return {
+        P602_AGGREGATE_MODEL_REF: {
+            "byte_length": P602_AUTHORITY[1],
+            "path": P602_DELTA,
+            "procedure_model_ref": P602_AGGREGATE_MODEL_REF,
+            "sha256": P602_AUTHORITY[0],
+        },
+        P5_NORMAL_PROBABILITY_MODEL_REF: {
+            "byte_length": P5_AUTHORITY[1],
+            "path": P5_TERMINAL_PROJECTION,
+            "procedure_model_ref": P5_NORMAL_PROBABILITY_MODEL_REF,
+            "sha256": P5_AUTHORITY[0],
+        },
+        P5_NORMAL_QUANTILE_MODEL_REF: {
+            "byte_length": P5_AUTHORITY[1],
+            "path": P5_TERMINAL_PROJECTION,
+            "procedure_model_ref": P5_NORMAL_QUANTILE_MODEL_REF,
+            "sha256": P5_AUTHORITY[0],
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _predecessor_part_ownership() -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    owners: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for shard, path in (
+        ("P6-01", P601_DELTA),
+        ("P6-02", P602_DELTA),
+        ("P6-03", P603_DELTA),
+    ):
+        for part in _load(path)["records"]["question_parts"]:
+            part_id = part["question_part_id"]
+            if part_id in owners:
+                raise RuntimeError("predecessor QuestionPart identity is duplicated")
+            owners[part_id] = {
+                "predecessor_procedure_model_ref": part.get("procedure_model_ref"),
+                "predecessor_shard": shard,
+                "predecessor_status": part["status"],
+            }
+    return owners
+
+
+def _semantic_posture(part_id: str, routes: tuple[str, ...], branch_key: str = "main") -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "confidence_interpretation_posture": (
+            "fixed_parameter_not_assigned_posterior_probability; contextual_statement_is_evidence_bound"
+            if any(route in {"mean_ci", "prop_ci", "interval_design", "coverage"} for route in routes)
+            else "not_applicable"
+        ),
+        "continuity_correction_posture": (
+            "correct_integer_total_boundary_applied_before_normalisation"
+            if "continuity_correction" in branch_key
+            else "no_continuity_correction_or_not_applicable_as_visibly_accepted"
+        ),
+        "estimator_or_parameter_ownership": (
+            "population_mean_and_population_variance_owned_by_sample_mean_and_n_minus_1_estimator"
+            if "estimate" in routes else
+            "population_proportion" if "prop_ci" in routes else
+            "population_mean" if any(route in {"mean_ci", "interval_design"} for route in routes) else
+            "sampling_distribution_or_context_as_visibly_named"
